post: The world is ending. Climate change. Global pandemics. War. AI and gambling are the only sectors holding our economy up. Everything that is fake and plastic is coming for all we hold dear. Art, culture, sports. Personally I don't really get the fuss some of you make about AI art. There are no real working artists today, just marketing execs with theater-kid social capital pushing NFTs and prediction markets. To me, AI replacing artists isn't a distinct issue from AI replacing all kinds of white-collar workers. Which is still a big issue, but you don't get to feel like an 'artist' or whatever for arguing about it online. People on here complain about the lack of a monoculture. Well, we do have a monoculture. Culture is more monocultural than ever. Even if the shitty memes and derivative video essays and saccharine self help bullshit and instagram reel slop we all consume differ in context, they all follow the same templates. Oh and sports suck now too. Also movies and TV and video games. And journalism and books and restaurants and pretty much all the internet save this forum, which seems somewhat resistant to this entropy towards slop but is still ramping downhill. Doesn't it all just seem to pile up on top of itself. It's not that any of these things will end the world. These are signs of something greater. Some greater threat that we cannot possibly predict, but when you think about the state of the world right now, about the state of reality itself, it seems obvious that everything is collapsing around on itself, orbiting true calamity, which is growing everyday, nearing our physical realm about to consume it all.
author: doomsayer33
title: world ending
